question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing striker, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing left winger, and Eve is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) striker
(C) cheerleader
(D) left winger
(E) goalkeeper
solution:
Positions in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve.
Initial: right midfielder | striker | cheerleader | left winger | goalkeeper
1. Eve swaps with Dave: right midfielder | striker | cheerleader | goalkeeper | left winger
2. Bob swaps with Eve: right midfielder | left winger | cheerleader | goalkeeper | striker
3. Bob swaps with Dave: right midfielder | goalkeeper | cheerleader | left winger | striker
4. Alice swaps with Claire: cheerleader | goalkeeper | right midfielder | left winger | striker
5. Claire swaps with Dave: cheerleader | goalkeeper | left winger | right midfielder | striker
Claire is playing left winger, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
